author: Retro Game Corps
description:
If you have a higher-end AYN or Retroid device (like the Odin 3, AYN Thor, or Retroid Pocket 6), recent underclocking apps will give you improved performance and battery life while also reducing CPU temperatures and fan noise. It's a rare win-win scenario when it comes to gaming.
